, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Joseph McGrath had the same (American) nationality as Thomas H. Ince by misreading “SC” (Scotland) as “South Carolina” and “normalizing” it to the U.S. This ignored the WebSurfer’s cited sources (Wikipedia, IMDb) clearly stating McGrath is Scottish (UK). Consequently, the Planner wrongly answered that they share the same nationality.
